name: Data Preview Threshing
implementation_notes: Dual-mode component (list/detail driven by :id? route param), mirrors DataPreviewCagesTrackView.vue's watch()-driven mode switch exactly

Detail mode renders the Threshing Detail grid read-only straight from stored columns (no recomputation, historical data), however many rows the record actually has (REVISED 2026-08-24: no longer always 24 -- this screen required NO functional code change for the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-add-row revision, since it already rendered `details.length` rows directly and already had an empty-state for zero rows) plus the same static Target Operasional reference table used by Form Threshing (screen-041)
Checked By/Acknowledged By rendered read-only with no role restriction on viewing, consistent with Data Preview Cages Track and this screen's business spec

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec (mobile/tests/e2e/data-preview-threshing.spec.ts) was authored but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review.
